cards.title: Reading the diagram
items: The middle region holds the skills that watch the field and keep its radars current; each sublabel names the source concern the skill lives in.
Regions below hold the outside skills these rely on, and regions above the outside skills that rely on these, each titled by its home functional area.

Stats: R = unique published rubric criteria (– = no publication); C = script-source bytes including tests/shared code: 0, S <10 KiB, M <100 KiB, L ≥100 KiB; F = reference files, including rubric. Recursive physical files only.
An arrow runs from a skill to the skill it relies on, downward between regions: solid is ki-depends-on composition, dashed is ki-optional-depends-on augmentation.

cards.title: Generated, not drawn
items: 3 skills, 0 outside prerequisites, 0 outside dependents, 0 composition and 0 optional edges, read from SKILL.md frontmatter.
Home in another area: ki-acquire; only edges within this area are drawn for them here, and their home area's diagram draws the rest.
Regenerate with ki repo conform --skill ki-repo-backpack; ki-skills KI-SHAPE-20 keeps the edges resolvable and acyclic.
